R6I-camp-camp-0001.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a rec site (estimate).

evidence.t: Named water: easy to find on any map.
1 km or more from pavement and from private land: quieter (estimate).

plan: Drive: from City of Terrace, about 100 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Beam Station Rd, Queensway Dr, Hwy 16, Hwy 16 and 37. Official directions to Jonas Creek rec site: From Highway 16 in Telkwa, turn onto Hankin Ave which turns into Riverside Street as you cross the bridge over the Bulkley River.
Park: 54.60454, -127.41526, the rec site. Map links below.
Camp: 5 campsites (official).
Hunt: 8 hunting spots within 5 km of this camp (my pick).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-9, Region 6. 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.

R6I-camp-camp-0001.recDirections: From Highway 16 in Telkwa, turn onto Hankin Ave which turns into Riverside Street as you cross the bridge over the Bulkley River. Stay on the same road and it turns into Telkwa Coalmine Rd. Stay right on Telkwa Coalmine road until you see the turn for Telkwa River FSR on your left, proceed up Telkwa River FSR. Continue down the Telkwa River Forest Service Road for 21.1km, Jonas Creek Recreation Site will be on your left.

evidence.t: Unnamed wetland, 20.4 ha, 100 m from the road.
